ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a horizontal motion trajectory, and the toy car starts from the Start position on the left. The labels show: Start corresponds to 0 s; 6 cm corresponds to 0.1 s; 24 cm corresponds to 0.2 s; 54 cm corresponds to 0.3 s; the far-right 96 cm corresponds to 0.4 s. The problem statement explains that the car starts from rest and undergoes uniformly accelerated motion. Reasoning: It asks for the instantaneous speed of the car at 96 cm from the starting point. Convert 96 cm to 0.96 m; at this time t = 0.4 s. The car starts from rest, and the displacement satisfies x = (1/2)at^2, so a = 2x/t^2 = 2(0.96)/(0.4^2) = 1.92/0.16 = 12 m/s^2. The instantaneous speed v = at = 12 × 0.4 = 4.8 m/s.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as showing the cart at 96 cm from the start at t = 0.4 s, with earlier checkpoints 6 cm at 0.1 s, 24 cm at 0.2 s, and 54 cm at 0.3 s confirming constant acceleration from rest. From the text, use that the toy car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly. Convert 96 cm to 0.96 m. Apply x = (1/2) a t^2 from rest to find a = 2x/t^2 = 2(0.96)/(0.4^2) = 12 m/s^2, then instantaneous velocity at that time is v = at = 12(0.4) = 4.8 m/s.

推理：要求小车在离起点 96 cm 处的瞬时速度。将 96 cm 转换为 0.96 m，此时 t = 0.4 s。小车从静止出发，位移满足 x = (1/2)at^2，所以 a = 2x/t^2 = 2(0.96)/(0.4^2) = 1.92/0.16 = 12 m/s^2。瞬时速度 v = at = 12 × 0.4 = 4.8 m/s。

method.method_draft: Read from the diagram that the cart travels 96 cm in the first 0.4 s, starting at the marked start position at 0 s. From the text, note that the motion begins from rest and acceleration is uniform, so velocity increases linearly with time. For uniformly accelerated motion from rest, the average velocity over 0 to t equals half the final instantaneous velocity: v_avg = v_final/2. Compute v_avg = displacement/time = 0.96 m / 0.4 s = 2.4 m/s, so v_final = 2v_avg = 4.8 m/s at the 96 cm mark.

推理：要求的是小车在距起点 96 cm 处的瞬时速度。由图可读出，小车从 0 s 到 0.4 s 运动了 96 cm，即 0.96 m。平均速度为 v_avg = 位移/时间 = 0.96 m / 0.4 s = 2.4 m/s。由于小车从静止开始且匀加速，速度随时间线性增加，因此从 0 到该时刻的平均速度等于末速度的一半，即 v_avg = v_final / 2。所以 v_final = 2 × 2.4 m/s = 4.8 m/s。
